name: combobox-28
description: Branch switcher opened from a compact button with a default-branch badge.

files.content: "use client" import { GitBranchIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList, ComboboxTrigger, ComboboxValue, } from "@workspace/ui/components/combobox" type Branch = { name: string; updated: string; isDefault?: boolean } const branches: Branch[] = [ { name: "main", updated: "2h ago", isDefault: true }, { name: "feat/billing-portal", updated: "20m ago" }, { name: "fix/date-picker-tz", updated: "1d ago" }, { name: "chore/upgrade-deps", updated: "3d ago" }, ] export default function GitBranchSwitcher() { return ( branch.name} > } > No branches found. {(branch: Branch) => ( {branch.name} {branch.isDefault ? ( default ) : ( {branch.updated} )} )} ) }
